title: STATISTICAL ANALYSIS AND TIME SERIES
description: This graduate course is only for M.S. Program in Financial Engineering students. Empirical analysis of asset prices: heavy tails, test of the predictability of stock returns. Financial time series: ARMA, stochastic volatility, and GARCH models. Regression models: linear regression and test of CAPM, non-linear regression and fitting of term structures.
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: IEOR E4702 Probability Corequisites: IEOR E4706 , IEOR E4707
raw_title_text: IEOR E4709 STATISTICAL ANALYSIS AND TIME SERIES. 3.00 points .
